report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: all sampled checkout traces return 200 across order, inventory, payment, and postgres save_order, and order metrics show only 200s on /v1/orders with no 502s. The deployment record shows only baseline order v1.0.0 with no prior version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No bounded cause is supported; logs were excluded and are needed.
